## 03b See a value that is not up to date

[![Where 03b See a value that is not up to date sits in Sign in](FLOW.desk.svg)](../WALKTHROUGH.desk.md)

| Previous | Next |
|:---|---:|
| ← *Identified, but a pot could not be brought up to date* (when `pot-not-brought-up-to-date` happens) from [02 Identify themselves](../02-identify/STEP.desk.md) | **End:** the saver is signed in, and knows which value is not up to date. |
| ← *Comes back identified, but a pot could not be brought up to date* (when `pot-not-brought-up-to-date` happens) from [02a Choose Google](../02a-google/STEP.desk.md) |  |

One provider could not be reached, so one pot's value could not be brought up to date. It is shown as the value last
known, and when that was, and the overview says so. The total includes it as last known.
